title: Ablation: stop_gradient between steps (True vs False) for double-step+AttnPool (48/96, d=5, ratio=0.6)
abstract: Evaluate whether stopping gradients from step1→step2 helps stability/performance for the compute-equalized double-step LN-ConvLSTM with single-head AttnPool.
